levy_year_status: 2025 is the most recent COMPLETE levy year (summer July 2025 + winter Dec 2025). 2026 summer levy published 6/25/2026; 2026 winter levy (Dec 2026) not yet published as of 2026-10-07.

non_homestead.notes: summer; NON-HOMESTEAD ONLY (businesses, rentals, second homes); homestead exempt via Principal Residence Exemption

notes: CITY taxes (EGR) are only the five 'City of EGR' lines (~13.8-13.9 mills, ~29-31% of a homestead bill). Schools, Kent County, Kent ISD, GRCC, State Ed Tax, The Rapid, and KDL are separate taxing authorities the city does not control.
EGR SCH-OPER 18 mills applies ONLY to non-homestead property (commercial, rental, second homes). Homestead (primary residence) is exempt.
STATE EDUC TAX 6 mills is a state levy on all property.

The two 'PARK IMPROVEMENTS' lines are city debt-service levies for the Nov 2021 $7M parks bond program ($5.180M sold Apr 2022; $1.735M sold Feb 2025). The city levies only what debt service requires each year.

2026 summer levy published 6/25/2026 in the city's official millage document; 2026 winter levy (county jail/senior/veterans/zoo/early-childhood, KDL) is set in December and was not yet published as of 2026-10-07.

parking_proposal.ballot_language_summary: Shall the City of East Grand Rapids borrow not to exceed $9,000,000 and issue general obligation unlimited tax bonds (one or more series, payable over not to exceed 20 years per series) to pay a portion of the cost of designing, acquiring and constructing a public parking facility on Bagley on or near the existing EGR Public Schools parking lot, site acquisition, site work, traffic signals at Lake and Bagley/San Lu Rae, designing and constructing pedestrian and micromobility safety infrastructure, and related expenses and improvements?
parking_proposal.companion_ballot_item_same_day: Kent County Corrections & Detention Millage: 0.98-mill renewal+increase for 2026-2045 (replaces 0.7332-mill 2026 certified rate; +0.2468 mill; est. $37.33M first-year levy). If passed, EGR winter COUNTY-JAIL line rises accordingly.
parking_proposal.correction_note: Commission adopted a corrected resolution (2026-147-A) fixing a technical error in the average millage figure from 0.44925 to 0.4925

computed_arithmetic.method: mills x (taxable value / 1000). Taxable value is generally ~50% of market value under Proposal A, lower for long-held homes due to cap. These are arithmetic, NOT official city estimates.

estimated_annual_cost_on_sample_home.official_city_dollar_figure: NOT FOUND - ballot language states millage only; no official sample-home dollar figure located in public records
estimated_annual_cost_on_sample_home.secondary_reference: A resident commenter cited ~$157/year first year using the 'average EGR taxable value' (~$265,000); unverified, not an official figure.
